description.value:
Duration constant

One additional Overreach attempt per day.

You may attempt one additional Overreach per day. The first Overreach you attempt each day does not risk Blown Cover — the day's first job is the one you have actually planned for.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Overreach" / the Blown Cover Table has zero Foundry-schema footprint. classes.scavenger-spy.json has no SpecialResource for Overreach uses/day (SpecialResource can model a one-way daily pool via renew:false, but none is defined here), and the Blown Cover Table itself is a GM random table with no representation in any card.
